Investigate how the [[Naga]]s that have been appearing over the island manages to travel undetected.

==Quest information==

===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| complete = [[The Road Less Traveled]]
}}

===Objectives===
*Travel to [[Haiju Lagoon]] and talk to [[Scout Shenfai]].
*Head North to the beach to look for [[Naga]]. Report your findings to Scout Shenfai. 
*See Scout Shenfai for your reward. 

===Reward===
*2500 [[Experience]]
*150 [[Gold]]
*[[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
It's preferable to wait with this quest until you have unlocked [[Zen Daijun (outpost)]], as the route is shorter and the henchmen are of a higher level. Otherwise you have to travel from [[Seitung Harbor]]. In either case, make your way to Scout Shenfai, talk to him, and then travel north and then northeast. There are no extra foes on the route. Once near the beach, clear the normal nagas from the area, and then investigate the beach location indicated. A group of nagas will spawn, defeat them. This is repeated two more times. Take care to only trigger one group at a time. After that, you can go back and collect the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Captain Zinghu
''I am glad to see you, <Player name>. I was telling a friend of mine about your run-in with the Naga at Zen Nai Falls. He's a scout, so I thought he would be interested. He was, and in fact, he thinks he might have an idea of where they are coming from. If you are not too busy with your studies, you should speak with him about the Naga problem. His name is '''Scout Shenfai''', and he lives in '''Haiju Lagoon'''. Perhaps together, you can pinpoint the source of these foul creatures.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = This sounds like a challenge!  I'm in.
| decline = It sounds like your friend has it covered.
| ask = '''Scout Shenfai''' often travels extensively throughout these lands, but I know that he is home for the time being. You can find him in '''Haiju Lagoon'''.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Scout Shenfai
''So you are the one that my friend Zinghu speaks of so highly. You impressed him, you know. Not an easy task, that. I'm sure he told you that I have been trying to locate where the Naga are coming in from, but the truth is, I haven't gotten too far. I tracked them down to the beach north of here, but then I noticed something that has left me stumped. They seem to swarm there, then suddenly disappear, and I never see them south of the lake. Strange, I know, but maybe you can check it out.''

===Reward dialogue===
;Scout Shenfai
''Of course! The Naga have been using the subterranean tunnels! Why did I not think of that? Obviously, the tunnels extend much farther than we imagined.... I will send word onto Captain Zinghu and fill him in on what you have found.''
